full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media fashion portrait presents a woman in stark black and white with a narrow band of distressed color. A woman with a short dark bob and black jacket fills the frame from the shoulders upward. She faces nearly forward, tilting her head slightly, her mouth parted. One pale hand rises to her cheek and partly covers the lower face; its fingers are long and close together. A horizontal strip of torn, layered magazine color crosses directly over both eyes, masking them. Within the strip, muted mustard yellow, coral red, faded turquoise, and gray-black fragments overlap with scratches and misaligned edges. The rest of her face and hand are rendered as a high-contrast grayscale photograph: pale forehead, smooth cheek, hard dark nose shadow, full black lips, and a deep neck shadow. Behind her, a rough wall-like collage of charcoal and dirty ivory rectangles shows scrapes, pasted paper edges, faint printing residue, and irregular painterly swipes. The lower border breaks into nearly solid black. The close editorial crop makes the blindfold strip the only significant colored line, while the hand provides a vertical counter-shape. Photographic realism coexists with physically torn paper and dry paint; surface scratches and glue-like seams remain visible. Lighting is dramatic from the upper left, leaving the right side of the head and neck in heavy shadow. The image feels mysterious, gritty, and tactile, like an experimental magazine cover or gallery photomontage. There are no readable words, logos, or frames.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介时装肖像呈现黑白女子，画面中有一条破旧的彩色亮带。短深色波波头女子从肩部以上充满画面。她几乎正面朝向观者，头稍微倾斜，嘴唇微张。一只苍白的手抬至脸颊，遮住部分下半张脸；手指修长而并拢。一条由杂志彩页撕贴叠成的横带直接穿过两眼，将眼睛遮住。带内低饱和芥末黄、珊瑚红、褪色青蓝和灰黑碎片互相重叠，有划痕和错开的边。其余面孔与手呈高反差灰度摄影效果：浅色额头、光滑脸颊、深硬鼻影、乌黑丰唇和深沉颈部阴影。身后，炭黑与脏象牙白矩形拼成粗糙墙面般背景，可见刮擦、贴纸边、淡淡印刷残迹和不规则绘画刮痕。下边缘断入近乎纯黑。紧密的编辑式裁切令眼前贴带成为唯一显著的彩色横线，而手形成竖向制衡形。摄影真实感与真正撕开的纸、干涩颜料并存，表面划痕与胶贴接缝仍然可见。光从左上方强烈照入，头和脖子的右侧陷入厚重阴影。画面神秘、粗粝而可触，像实验性杂志封面或画廊摄影拼贴。没有可读文字、标志或边框。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast grayscale photography meets rough analog collage and narrow accents of distressed color. Large light areas are chalky and large dark areas velvety black, with abrupt tonal boundaries rather than soft commercial retouching. Torn paper fragments, scraped paint, ghosted print residue, and slightly misregistered rectangles give every plane a physically pasted quality. One compact band of mustard, coral, and faded cyan interrupts an otherwise charcoal, gray, and dirty-ivory palette. A close, almost confrontational crop creates strong horizontal-versus-vertical shape tension. Sharp light from one upper side carves dimensional planes, while outer edges merge into shadow and abrasion. Paper fibers, grain, scuffs, irregular seams, and uneven ink density remain visible. The finished image resembles an experimental editorial photomontage with both photographic clarity and handmade damage.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差灰度摄影与粗糙手工拼贴相遇，仅有少量狭窄的磨损彩色重音。大块亮面粉笔般苍白，大块暗面呈天鹅绒黑，明暗边界突然而非商业修图式柔滑。撕纸碎片、刮去的颜料、幽微印刷残迹与略错位的矩形层叠，使每个平面都有实际贴上的质感。一条紧凑的芥末黄、珊瑚红和褪色青蓝色带打断原本由炭黑、灰和脏象牙白组成的配色。贴近、近乎直面的裁切形成强烈的横竖形体张力。来自上方一侧的锐利光线刻出立体平面，外侧边缘则融入阴影和磨损。纸纤维、颗粒、擦伤、不规则接缝与不均匀墨色仍然可见。成品如实验性编辑摄影拼贴，兼具摄影的清晰和手工损伤的痕迹。
theme_en: A blindfolded monochrome fashion portrait with torn color collage
theme_zh: 以撕贴彩色遮住眼睛的黑白时装肖像
name: Nick Gentry
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
